description: List a monitor's past checks (newest first): timestamps, status, alerted flag, percent difference, errors. Use get_check for the full detail of one check. pageAccess says what the browser reached; when reachedContent is false the check saw a challenge, login or error page, so report that, not a change in content.

includeHidden.description: Include changes the user hid (hide_change). Default false.

status.description: Filter by status: ALERT_SENT, CHANGE, NO_CHANGE, or ERROR

name: get_check_history
title: Get check history
